text: Sofia. Six girls, four days. Marrakech in March is peak — bougainvillea, jasmine, golden hour. I have the city dialed in.

speaker: aria
text: La Mamounia, three nights. I held the Mamounia Suite — garden access, Atlas view from the terrace. Karim at the spa knows you're coming. Welcome rose-petal hammam at four.
